issues.detail: The corrected PE probe finds 6,643 file-backed RIP-relative instructions but zero direct references to the exact starts of the 54 diagnostic strings. No candidate is proven to be the Galaxy VM execution entrypoint.

issues.detail: Fresh launcher-owned ports 5993-5995 reached CreateGame/JoinGame, but the VEH observer saw high-volume generic 0x80000003 traffic and the pre-seeded GalaxyVibe Bank remained an empty shell. No same-window record links Galaxy breakpoint; an attributable VEH event; and Bank trace_before/trace_after.
issues.nextAction: Add a filtered event-source observer or an explicitly persisted map startup marker, then repeat the trace. Keep hook_enabled=false until the causal chain is independently attributable.

residual_risks.detail: Promoting a false-positive address could crash SC2 or corrupt a running map; the profile must remain hook_enabled=false until independent verification passes.
